'''2009 Bespin Regionals Ian Campbell LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ian Campbell]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hamdogs
* '''Username:''' Runner
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
